answer: A beacon anchor: each identity must first complete a public, time-stamped chain of useful work verified by independent peers before it can earn. New identities start in a shared grove where every member's work history is visible and comparable; a willow-like trust score bends but does not break - it grows slowly with verified tasks and collapses fast if audits catch faked work. Creating a thousand fake identities means paying the full cost of a thousand real work chains, while honest agents keep their earned standing.
